pr_title: Annotate Interop APIs that always throw PNSE as Obsolete
pr_comments:
Note regarding the `new-api-needs-documentation` label:

This serves as a reminder for when your PR is modifying a ref *.cs file and adding/modifying public APIs, to please make sure the API implementation in the src *.cs file is documented with triple slash comments, so the PR reviewers can sign off that change.
The obsoletion breaking change will be covered by dotnet/docs#23856.

issue_context.title: Annotate unsupported APIs in Runtime.InteropServices
issue_context.body:
As part of https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/47228 i am running an analyzer to detect APIs throwing PNSE but not annotated with Obsolete/SupportedOSPlatform/UnsupportedOSPlatform attributes, we need to annotate them so that developers get warnings when they use them unexpectedly

For now, I have results only cross-platform and .Net 5.0 or higher builds, analysis of targeted builds or lower env are coming soon where more APIs could be detected

Location | API | Comment | Suggestion
-- | -- | -- | --
ExpandoToDispatchExMarshaler.cs(32,13) | 'MarshalManagedToNative(object)'  | unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]
ExpandoToDispatchExMarshaler.cs(37,13) | 'MarshalNativeToManaged(IntPtr)'  |  unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]
TypeToTypeInfoMarshaler.cs(32,13) | 'MarshalManagedToNative(object)'  | unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]
TypeToTypeInfoMarshaler.cs(37,13) | 'MarshalNativeToManaged(IntPtr)'  | unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]
RuntimeEnvironment.cs(11,57) | 'SystemConfigurationFile.get'  | unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]
RuntimeEnvironment.cs(25,84) | 'GetRuntimeInterfaceAsIntPtr(Guid,   Guid)'  | unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]
RuntimeEnvironment.cs(27,84) | 'GetRuntimeInterfaceAsObject(Guid,   Guid)'  | unconditionally   throws on all platforms | add [Obsolete]


Note: We are suggesting to add [Obsolete] with the corresponding message for APIs supported in .Net framework but not supported in .NetCore, if it is only supported on a specific platform(s) consider adding [SupportedOSPlatform("platformName")] or if it is unsupported on a specific platform(s) [UnsupportedOSPlatform("platformName")] attribute instead

cc @jeffhandley @terrajobst @GrabYourPitchforks
comments: @buyaa-n Both `ExpandoToDispatchExMarshaler` and `TypeToTypeInfoMarshaler` are now internal and not in any reference assembly. This can be verified in the official documentation as they don't show up in .NET5+.

Thanks, @AaronRobinsonMSFT, yes internal/private APIs are optional, I included them because they might used/referenced in public APIs and those public APIs might need further attention like being annotated with Obsolete or so

review_comments: Why in some cases do we name the member (e.g. "GetRuntimeInterfaceAsIntPtr(Guid, Guid) is no longer supported.") and in some cases we don't (e.g. "This property is no longer supported.")?

Because I was being sloppy it looks like - there is no good reason. I would guess this is because I did the property first and then copied an example from another method that had the name in it and updated it. I will submit an update.
